cards.meaning: gap, distance, interval — the measurable space between two things in time, place or amount
cards.example: Lumobo sa pinakamalaking agwat sa kasaysayan ang kalakalan ng bansa noong Oktubre.
cards.exampleMeaning: The country's trade gap swelled to the widest in history in October.
cards.note: Mas pormal kaysa 'layo' at mas tiyak kaysa 'pagitan' — may sukat na puwedeng bilangin. Gamit sa ekonomiya: agwat ng mayaman at mahirap, agwat ng presyo. Idyoma: 'walang agwat' = sunud-sunod, walang pahinga.
cards.tiesTo: Philippines posts record $6.95B October trade deficit

cards.meaning: allocated, set aside, earmarked for a specific purpose; root: laan
cards.example: Inilaan ng Senado ang halos 20 bilyong piso mula sa ayuda tungo sa PhilHealth.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Senate set aside nearly ₱20 billion from cash aid for PhilHealth.
cards.note: Pormal; madalas sa badyet, batas at simbahan ('inilaan ang buhay sa paglilingkod'). Iba sa 'ibinigay': ang inilaan ay nakareserba pa lang, hindi pa naaabot ng tatanggap. Pandiwa: maglaan, naglaan, ilalaan.
cards.tiesTo: Senate shifts ₱19.8B from AICS/MAP aid to PhilHealth in 2027 budget

cards.meaning: to concentrate; concentrated — where gains, risks or resources pile up
cards.example: 今年的利润主要集中在高科技行业。
cards.examplePinyin: Jīnnián de lìrùn zhǔyào jízhōng zài gāo kējì hángyè.
cards.exampleMeaning: This year's profits are mainly concentrated in high-tech industries.
cards.note: Neutral register. Collocations: 集中在 + sector/place, 集中精力 (focus energy), 集中资源 (pool resources), 风险集中 (concentration risk). Contrast 聚集: physical gathering of people/things (人群聚集); 集中 is the abstract, analytical word and can describe deliberate action.
cards.tiesTo: China October industrial profits +20.1%, gains concentrated in high-tech and mining

cards.meaning: precisely, exactly — emphatic, often marking a point contrary to expectation
cards.example: 利润大涨恰恰说明消费还很弱。
cards.examplePinyin: Lìrùn dà zhǎng qiàqià shuōmíng xiāofèi hái hěn ruò.
cards.exampleMeaning: The profit surge shows precisely that consumption is still weak.
cards.note: Leans 书面语/argumentative. Collocations: 恰恰相反 (quite the contrary), 恰恰说明 (shows exactly that), 问题恰恰在这里. Contrast 正好: neutral coincidence ('happens to fit'); 恰恰 makes a pointed, often counter-intuitive claim.
cards.tiesTo: China profit surge vs CPI +0.7% and retail sales +0.4% — two-speed economy
